title: eryngium tricuspidatum subsp. mauritanicum
intro: Eryngium tricuspidatum subsp. mauritanicum, commonly known as Eryngium, is a plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of digestive issues, such as dyspepsia and gastritis, due to its health benefits of soothing inflammation and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Eryngium include its ability to stimulate appetite, ease nausea, and calm digestive upset, making it a valuable remedy for gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Eryngium include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
